title: High-order, long-time stable and parallel decoupled GBDF$k$ SAV ensemble schemes for the Navier--Stokes--Darcy flow with random hydraulic conductivity tensors
summary: We develop and analyze high-order ensemble schemes for the unsteady Navier--Stokes--Darcy system with uncertain initial conditions, forcing terms, hydraulic conductivity tensors, and Lions-Beavers-Joseph-Saffman interface conditions. The proposed schemes which are called GSAV-GBDF$k$-Ensemble schemes integrate a partitioned decoupling strategy, the generalized scalar auxiliary variable (GSAV) approach, and generalized BDF$k$ discretizations.
